items.t: The Defense Startup Taking a SpaceX Approach to Missiles
items.d: Defense startup Castelion has raised $1 billion at a $13 billion valuation as it races to scale production of its Blackbeard hypersonic weapon system and develop new long-range and defensive capabilities. items.t: Anthropic Expects to Match or Top SpaceX’s Record IPO Size
items.d: Anthropic PBC expects to match or beat the size of SpaceX’s record-setting initial public offering, according to people familiar with the matter, in the latest sign of overwhelming demand from investors looking to profit from the artificial intelligence boom.
